description:
List recent calls. Scope by agent_id or number_id, or use status/direction/search to filter globally.

When agent_id or number_id is passed, status/direction/search filters are not applied.
Returns call summaries including each call's ID, direction, participants, and status.

agent_id.description: Show only calls handled by this agent (ID from list_agents).

direction.description: Keep only inbound calls or only outbound calls — one of "inbound" or "outbound".

limit.description: How many calls to return in one page.

number_id.description: Show only calls on this phone number (ID from list_numbers).

offset.description: How many calls to skip before this page, for paging.

search.description: Match calls by phone number or keyword.

status.description: Keep only calls in this state, e.g. ringing, in-progress, completed, failed, busy, or no-answer.

name: list_calls

items.description: A phone call and, when available, its transcript.

agentId.description: ID of the agent that handled the call, or null.

endedAt.description: When the call ended (ISO 8601), or null if still active.

id.description: The call's unique ID (use as call_id in get_call).

phoneNumberId.description: ID of the phone number used for the call.

status.description: Call status, e.g. ringing, in-progress, completed, failed.

items.description: One human/agent turn of the call transcript.

response.description: What the agent said in response, or null.

transcript.description: What the human said on this turn.

hasMore.description: Whether more results exist beyond this page.

total.description: Total matching records across all pages.

title: List Calls
